description:
Criteria: Owner demonstrates individual member accounts and privacy, two members competing for one slot, the seven-day boundary, two-upcoming-booking cap, cancellation cutoff and released capacity. The first version matches README and owner setup answers.
Artifact: Working local app, automated test evidence and a short staff account-management guide.
Prerequisites: T-008. Guest payments and production deployment remain excluded.
Stage-1 limitation: this is an ordinary ticket; Storybloq does not enforce an owner approval gate.
title: Checkpoint: first-version acceptance
